name: job-hunter
description: Guided job search for any field. Onboards from your resume and an interview, builds your career file and job preferences (role, pay, location, dealbreakers), re-interviews you to keep the career file sharp, rewrites your resume as an expert and saves a reusable template, scans employer job feeds and the boards you are signed in to, reviews postings with honest fit and knock-out checks, and builds a tailored resume as a real .docx and PDF, checked for copied text and untraceable claims, with a tracker.
